description: Demographic parity enforcement vs aggregate calibration accuracy
finding: At lambda_f=0 the maximum group deviation reaches 4.2 pp, concentrated in the 18-24 age bracket where the panel has the fewest respondents. lambda_f=0.2 reduces it to 1.8 pp, satisfying the 2 pp demographic-parity threshold at a JS penalty of only 0.002 above the unconstrained optimum.
